champion.name: Industry Diffusion + Weekly Low-MAX
champion.holding: exact frozen 20-session lifecycle and QD-010 execution

chronology.annual_return: compound exact replay daily NAV returns within calendar year; 2018 starts from frozen initial capital
chronology.monthly_return: compound exact replay daily NAV returns within calendar month

market_alpha.broad_proxy: daily cross-sectional median causal step_return compounded over the same post-signal 20-session descriptive window
market_alpha.industry_proxy: daily equal-weight mean causal step_return in the PIT industry compounded over the same post-signal 20-session descriptive window

classification.BETA_DOMINATED: year is absolutely negative while mean selected net payoff exceeds both broad and industry proxies
classification.RELATIVE_ALPHA_FAILED: mean selected net payoff is no better than both broad and industry proxies

strategy_layer.champion: exact frozen Industry Diffusion plus weekly Low-MAX replay
strategy_layer.increment: champion annual return minus baseline annual return; descriptive arithmetic difference

continuation_rotation.industry_path: compound PIT-industry equal-weight return and broad-relative return after signal
continuation_rotation.opportunity_persistence: fraction of original selected industries still in top-10 industries by frozen diffusion_score at checkpoint
continuation_rotation.rank_quality: cross-sectional percentile rank of original selected industry diffusion_score at checkpoint
continuation_rotation.control: each losing year versus individual and pooled profitable years

loss_concentration.tail_concentrated: worst 10 percent of trades explain at least 60 percent of gross negative trade PnL
loss_concentration.broad: worst 10 percent explain at most 40 percent and residual annual trade PnL remains negative

winner_loser.winner_collapse: winner rate or mean winner is below the minimum profitable-year observation
winner_loser.loser_expansion: severe-loss incidence exceeds the maximum profitable-year observation or mean loser is below the minimum profitable-year observation

execution.turnover_proxy: entry-year realized round-trip notional divided by frozen initial capital; diagnostic, not accounting-year engine turnover
execution.coverage: executed frozen trades divided by planned frozen selections by signal year
execution.cost_drag: 20 bps each side applied to realized entry and exit notionals

prohibited: champion modification, repair, filter, sizing, or hypothetical improved return
market, volatility, breadth, dispersion, or regime veto
Top-N, holding, stop, exit, Low-MAX, Industry Diffusion, cost, or clock change
classifier, clustering, regression, LightGBM, tree, or parameter search
OOS, independent-validation, live, or production claim
